sites.ownership: The appearance panel controller owns its programmatic-sync guard.
sites.justification: Opening or refreshing the panel must update toggle and tile state without recursively writing GSettings.

sites.ownership: The appearance panel controller owns the app-appearance button set.
sites.justification: Theme buttons are built dynamically around GTK toggle groups and need one mutable collection for syncing and signal wiring.

sites.ownership: The appearance panel controller owns the editor palette tile set.
sites.justification: Palette preview tiles are built dynamically and refreshed when app appearance changes without rebuilding the window shell.
